# Florent Berrez

> Software engineer in Paris, France. Builds small, focused products: desktop tools, developer ergonomics, quiet web things. Keyboard-first when it matters, boring tech, considered defaults.

## About

- **Name:** Florent Berrez (also: Flo Berrez, fberrez)

- **Website:** https://www.fberrez.co
- **Email:** hi@fberrez.co

- **Company:** mambo-corp (https://github.com/mambo-corp)
- **Philosophy:** Makes small software and finishes it.

## Currently shipping

- [foyer](https://usefoyer.app): Ambient soundscapes you arrange in space. Place sounds around you, set the mood, play it from the Mac notch. macOS and iOS.
- [minihabits](https://minihabits.co): A minimalist habit tracking app. One screen, tap, done. Habits built on momentum, not streaks. No onboarding, no settings, no notifications. iOS.
- [mambo](https://trymambo.app): Keyboard-driven desktop database client for macOS and Linux. Connects to PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, MongoDB, Redis, SQLite, ClickHouse, DuckDB, Elasticsearch, and Cassandra. Flagship project. Built with Tauri 2 + React + TypeScript.
- [quietdash.com](https://quietdash.com): A quiet dashboard. Numbers that matter, nothing that doesn't. Single-screen metrics view. In progress.

## Archived

- towncenter: Prospect neighbourhood shops from a map.
- blurt.sh: Markdown in, posts everywhere.

## Stack

TypeScript, React, Astro, NestJS, Tauri, Node.js, Rust, Go, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Docker.
